updates.note: Management stated they significantly surpassed the 10% order inflow guidance for FY26.
updates.quote: On order inflows, we had guided for a growth of 10% for FY26 at the start of the year. I am pleased to share that we have significantly surpassed this guidance

updates.note: Revenue growth for FY26 stood at 12% compared to the 15% guidance.
updates.quote: On the revenue front, growth for FY26 stood at 12% compared to our guidance of 15%.

updates.note: Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio improved sharply to 4.1% as of March 2026.
updates.quote: As of March 2026, the Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio improved sharply to 4.1%

updates.note: P&M margin guidance for FY26 was not explicitly updated or discussed against the old range.

new_promises.statement: Expect group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect revenue growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
new_promises.quote: we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect Projects, Products and Manufacturing (PP&M) margin to be stable at 7.8% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well.
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect working capital to be around 10% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: accordingly, we are guiding the working capital to be around 10% in FY27
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Target order inflow growth at a CAGR of 10% to 12% over the next five years under Lakshya 31.
new_promises.quote: over the next five years, we are targeting order inflow growth at a CAGR return of 10% to 12%
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Target revenue growth of 12% to 15% over the next five years under Lakshya 31.
new_promises.quote: revenue growth of 12% to 15%, and a Return on Equity in the range of 16% to 17%
new_promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
